v0.2.0.description:
# New Features
- Adding new item: double job tokens. You can disable this in the yaml config
- While using the map, the stations will be coloured red if you do not have the corresponding station license, or green if you have
- No more save file generated, everything the game needs will be asked through network to the AP Server. As a user, this means that it is easier to setup.
# Known bugs
- Death Link still does not work as intended. The option is there, but it seemingly does nothing
- Instead of quitting nicely, the game often crashes when quitting the game. This should not have any impact on save file or overall performance
# Future Plans
- Integrating station licenses into career managers instead of paper.
- Changing specific aspects of the game to be included in the AP loop: For example, allowing the career manager on the caboose to be special (special hints?) Forcing some licenses to be required (train length, hazmat, concurrent jobs), etc...
v0.2.0.title: v0.2.0

v0.2.2.description:

v0.3.0.description:
# New features
 - New yaml options: Vanilla or AP gated demonstrator spawns; presence or absence of checks for demo loco spawns, and for museum completion; hints (or not) the item you can buy on the license screen of career managers.
 - New floating Archipelago logo to locate possible demo loco spawn points for checks (only present if you chose to have checks on spawn points). The logo is blue if you cannot get it yet due to lack of licenses, and multi-colored if you can get it.
 - Removed the job regeneration when sleeping (At first, it was to allow players with only one station and the shunting license to more easily get new jobs if they want to spam it, but this posed many problems as the regeneration also deleted locomotives on tracks). Now you can sleep to pass time and/or meteo conditions (just as vanilla) without breaking anything. To regenerate jobs, you can exit the station range (for example by teleporting to another station) and coming back in. **Free teleport is highly recommended to play this randomizer**.
 - Locations will be resynced from server when connecting to the slot with a different savefile (possibly on a different device). This allows slot advancement on different computers. **WARNING: This does not work when playing on two computers at the same time**
 
# Bug fixes
- Fixed not being able to start a new vanilla career with the mod installed.
- Fixed the remaining job count available in a station written on the job report page (there was twice the same number for the job that was just checked in -- either shunting or transport -- and the other).

# Known bug
I have noticed I have never documented this... There is (maybe not always) a sharp FPS decrease when playing a randomizer game. To solve this, change your graphical setting to something else that you have currently, apply, and then revert back to what you had (and apply)
v0.3.0.title: v0.3.0

v0.4.0.description:
- **New feature** New [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases) Map integration (Thanks to @FarisTheAncient!). Download the map pack at http://derail.wolfpack.xyz/ and provide it to universal tracker when prompted to.
- **New feature** New items: 50% off vouchers (to ease out the harsh money requirements, especially for demonstrator locomotives restoration) that you can toggle on or off in the yaml options
- **Change** Fragile license was removed as an item and was added to Hazmat license progression (now 4 stages, Fragile -> Hazmat 1 -> Hazmat 2 -> Hazmat 3)
- **Bug fix** Added some logic for impossible checks (CP station do not have any freight haul jobs, shunting jobs in MB station were so rare that they were removed, OR, OWN and OWC stations only have freight haul jobs requiring at least Hazmat 1)
